text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You again? Look, this is getting
annoying. What is it you want with
me,
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Who says I have anything to say?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The thing is, I have nothing. Nothing. A pretty face, a dumb doll. That's me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Modeling was fun at first, you know.
They'd ask me to look happy, or
strike a
pose, and they'd heap on the praise when I
did it. I was proud
of myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
They wanted a certain image from me, so
that's what I modeled
myself after, what I
performed.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But then one day, I was walking down the
street, when I saw this huge
poster of
myself. And I thought... "Who's that?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"This image of perfection brought to life,
like she was born to look
pretty. Who is
that?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't have to think twice to know the
answer—"That's 'Gold City,'
duh."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The real question was... "Who's the one standing here staring at her? Who am I ?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It scared me. I wanted to scream, and I
just, I couldn't take it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My mind just went blank and I took off
running, and I ran and ran...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And that's when I saw it... the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I legitimately had no clue where I was. And
I tripped... I don't even
know how many
times, my legs were caked in mud, my
favorite dress
was in tatters...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But the sky, I don't know why, but it was just so pretty.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...And that's when it hits me. This—this is me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: My legs hurt like hell, and my lungs felt like they were about to burst, but it all just felt like me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So I came to Tracen. To run and run, and to become me. To carve the real me into everyone's memory.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (The honk of a car horn cuts her off.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City! Thank goodness you're here! Did you
not get any of my calls?
Come on, you'll
be late for work.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Manager... Sorry, we were, er, busy
talking... Oh wow, yeah, that's a
lot of
missed calls.

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever it was, I'm glad I found
you. I assume something
happened with
that trainer?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, something like that. Sorry, uh, work.
Right, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, can we head back to the academy real
quick though? I need to
reserve the
training course.

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Listen, City. Don't you think it's about
time to give it up? You're
worn out, both
in body and mind. You've tried so, so hard.
Isn't it
tiring?

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
You don't like people judging you by your
looks, but that's just how it
is. You have to
learn to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you a top model. You should be
up on the stage where you'll
shine the
brightest. Forcing yourself into a world
where you don't
belong only brings pain.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A world where I don't belong... Hah,
maybe you're right. I thought I
was getting
somewhere, and look at me now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Maybe it's time to give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City slams the car door shut, and the
engine revs up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, I just watch them drive off
in a daze. But then, I notice
something on
the ground.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The lock screen's set to a picture of a
sunset. It's a bit blurry—her
hand must've
been shaking. But still, it's a beautiful
sight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I replay her words in my mind over and
over. For her, running is a way
to become
her true self.

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City, wait here a moment. I'm going to go
talk to the staff.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Mm, all right.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Damn, okay. She got a big name
photographer for this shoot. Bet
he'll make
me look really pretty.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You know... Maybe this is where I belong
after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, you... Why... How?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My dream? You're literally making zero
sense.

As confusion crosses her face, I pull out
the phone and show her the
lock screen.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! What the—Why do you have my
phone?! And why were you
looking
through it?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's not my dream! Not anymore—I quit already!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Give it back!
She snatches the phone from my hand.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm done. I'm through. I'm giving up! And
I'm deleting this picture!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll delete it right here, right now! I swear,
I'll... I'll delete it...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why can't I just... press delete?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Who are you, anyway? Like honestly.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're a nuisance, and a goody-two-shoes,
and a stalker,
eavesdropper, phone
peeper—you have zero tact, you're clingy,
and
so, so damn annoying!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: First you just wanna hear me out, and now it's "don't throw yourself away!" You never make any fricking sense! Seriously, who the hell do you think you are?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ughhhhh, I am SO done with you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fine then. Do it! Be my trainer. We'll see
how fast you can make me
run!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But I swear, treat me like a doll once, and I'll kick you so hard you'll regret ever talking to me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "sounds good"?! Ugh, I
can't.

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City, sorry to keep you waiting! Oh, uh...
You must be...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that, I'll tell you later. We've
got work to do. You, wait
here.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My manager's kind of a helicopter, so I'll
introduce you to her. As
my... my trainer.
